items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: But I know George was there. Jim was there. Little Jim at that time, he was playing the tuba.

ctx.x: How big was your band then in those days? Ten. About ten. About ten. About ten. About the same, did you use saxes then or clarinet and alitoes or what did you use?

Well, we were at clarinet and I just remember all the fellas, it's been so long time before. Twenty years. But I know George was there. Jim was there. Little Jim at that time, he was playing the tuba. Playing the tuba. Yeah.
I heard him even a couple years ago. He was still there.
